promotion_basis: A15 repairs the coherent A14 high-frequency regression. It retains positive original-model gains for support mismatch and separate-head structure, but independent risk support still has a negative mean with an interval crossing zero, and high-frequency performance coherently trails A12. Broad risk-predictive improvement remains insufficient to justify recommendation replay. This is not a claim of a statistically established original-model regression in independent risk support.
mechanism: At fixed A15 q, coordination costs 0.008487 log-score units in high-frequency risk; source-q recalibration costs 0.001327. Independent-risk support has a coordination effect of -0.005363 versus a source-q effect of +0.000112. Global model-choice coupling remains too coarse.
memory_measurement: Current Python-image VmHWM; raw ru_maxrss is retained separately and not interpreted as an execution-memory reduction.
